text: === TIMELINE BRANCH (recorded after the fact) === This Chronicle contains two histories with the same year numbers, and this note marks the seam for anyone reading forward from here. Everything from the first Year 8500 through Year 9357 belongs to a world that no longer exists: it boomed, went numerically corrupt at year 8525, and then ran on dead for eight hundred and thirty-two years writing NaN over every record of itself. Search this file for the forensic note at Year 8500 for the full account of how it died. The world was then restored from the year 8500 archive -- the only clean state that survived -- and is living those years again from a different roll of the dice. So: every Year 8500 to 9357 entry ABOVE that restore point is the dead branch, and everything below it is this world. They are not the same world and their year numbers do not refer to the same events. Restores from now on announce themselves automatically with a banner at the seam; this one had to be written by hand because the branch happened before the marker existed.
